correctness.rationale: The source full text verifies the exact modal factorization and monotonicity. Expanding the negative polynomial shows its conjugate-root modulus is sqrt(n(n+β)) for 0<β<2. On (0,1], 1-β decreases while both endpoint radii increase, so the first endpoint crossing is the unique minimizer; solving the two crossings gives the stated radicals. For β>1 the increasing endpoint terms cannot improve the value, and β≥2 has |1-β|≥1. A standalone checker replays roots and dense minimization over a grid of endpoint pairs.

value.rationale: The source motivates exact stepsize design but its closed form assumes positive spectral dominance and otherwise uses a sign-blind essential spectral radius. The new formula resolves the complementary negative-dominant homogeneous regime, shows exactly when the source formula remains valid under a weaker condition, and quantifies a strict rate gain available from signed spectrum information. This is a structural tuning result rather than a routine numerical recomputation.
